meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 当你要发布软件新版本时,Claude 会先确认版本类型(小修复/新功能/大改版),然后触发自动发布流程:生成发布说明、发布到 npm 和 GitHub、在 Discord 发公告,最后逐项验证发布结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等发布指令并指定版本类型(patch/minor/major)时触发;若没给版本类型,它会先停下来向你确认。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 它会开始发布流程并验证结果。

say.text: 发布 minor 版本,发布说明先给我过目
say.note: 它会先起草摘要供你确认。

say.text: 用 major 发布,发布后记得发 Discord 公告
say.note: 发布完成后它会在 Discord 发公告。

howto.what_en: On a publish request, Claude confirms the bump type, triggers the GitHub Actions workflow, drafts release notes, publishes npm/GitHub packages, posts to Discord, and verifies the results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says publish, release, deploy, etc., with a bump type (patch/minor/major); if no bump type is given, Claude stops and asks for one.

say_en.text: Publish a patch release for me.
say_en.note: It will run the publish workflow and verify.

say_en.text: Release a minor version; show me the draft summary first.
say_en.note: It will draft the summary for review.

say_en.text: Do a major release and post the Discord announcement after.
say_en.note: It will publish and announce on Discord.
